name: Potential Persistence Via Microsoft Office Startup Folder
description: Detects creation of Microsoft Office files inside of one of the default startup folders in order to achieve persistence.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Loading a user environment from a backup or a domain controller
query: (((file.path:*\\Microsoft\\Word\\STARTUP* OR (file.path:*\\Office* AND file.path:*\\Program\ Files* AND file.path:*\\STARTUP*)) AND (file.path:(*.doc OR *.docm OR *.docx OR *.dot OR *.dotm OR *.rtf))) OR ((file.path:*\\Microsoft\\Excel\\XLSTART* OR (file.path:*\\Office* AND file.path:*\\Program\ Files* AND file.path:*\\XLSTART*)) AND (file.path:(*.xls OR *.xlsm OR *.xlsx OR *.xlt OR *.xltm)))) AND (NOT (process.executable:(*\\WINWORD.exe OR *\\EXCEL.exe)))
